# telnyx_mobile_phone_numbers (Data Source)

Lists mobile phone numbers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_mobile_phone_number`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `mobile_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_phone_numbers))
